ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant high-intensity central region (approx. 80%) bordered by low-intensity marginal and central-medial pixel clusters (approx. 20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) contiguous band along the entire trailing edge and tips. A large, irregular low-intensity focal cluster is centered at the median notch and extends towards the fluke base. Sparse, discrete low-intensity mottling is visible on the lower interior portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 85 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes. The right lobe outer edge features a prominent, high-amplitude irregular indentation or 'step' at approximately 75% distance from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct structural indentation/gouging on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique plume-shaped dark pigmentation pattern radiating from the median notch into the central high-intensity ventral field.
